statements.t: “PACE-1 remains on track, and our recent financing has enabled us to expand the ALTO-207 Phase 3 development plans to include both monotherapy and adjunctive trials, aimed at supporting a broad label in TRD.”

• PACE-3 (Phase 3, monotherapy TRD): In July 2026, Alto announced plans to add a Phase 3 trial of ALTO-207 as monotherapy in TRD, which the Company believes could support a broader label and larger addressable patient population.
The Company expects its cash to fund planned operations through 2030.
